notes: Concord Inertial Dampener (utility, standard, 2x2): a heavy round mass hung in a clean square frame on four spring dampers (a piston and a coil each, bolted to the corners); the mass carries a ring of blue field lamps and the field ring round it pulses out (glow), the springs breathe a pixel in and out. Registry stencil, a green power lamp. Damaged: the lower-right damper has snapped and the mass has sagged a pixel toward it, the field ring stutters. Disabled: two dampers broken, the mass down on the frame with a cracked hub, the field dark.
